description.narrative: Apollo Agriculture is an agri-fintech company that enables smallholder farmers in Kenya and Zambia to engage in profitable and sustainable agriculture. Through innovative use of technology, data and a scalable distribution model, Apollo offers small-scale farmers a comprehensive solution that includes inputs, counselling, insurance and financing._x000D_ _x000D_ Swedfund's investment will enable Apollo to develop its operations to increase production capacity in the agricultural sector in Kenya with the support of new technology._x000D_ The investment contributes to the development and scaling up of sustainable processes and practices in the Kenyan agriculture and food sector. Furthermore, the investment is expected to contribute to jobs and other income-generating opportunities locally. The investment contributes to women's economic empowerment by increasing access to capital and products and services for women. The investment promotes adaptation and resilience in the agricultural sector in geographies affected by climate change.
